gold_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.675993 45.522611)',4326)) > 120
    THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no'
  END AS answer,
  ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.675993 45.522611)',4326)) AS elevation_m
FROM public.dem_us d
WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.675993 45.522611)',4326))
LIMIT 1;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.675993, 45.522611), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      rast,
      ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326),
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us,
    poi_geom p
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(
      ST_Transform(rast::geometry, 4326),
      p.geom::geometry
    )
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN MAX((ST_Value(clipped_rast, 1))::numeric) > 120 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS exceeds_120m
FROM
  dem_clip;
